      "text": "The lookup budget does not count block and undo reads, allowing queries that fit in the 50 MiB budget to read far more disk than intended.",
      "quote": "The lookup budget does not count block and undo reads. At verbosity 2, tx_to_json reads the full block and its undo data for every block that holds a non-coinbase match",

      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Use BigEndianFormatter<3> instead of introducing OrderedVarInt.",
      "quote": "OrderedVarInt could be BigEndianFormatter<3>. Big-endian already sorts by height, and the same key already uses it for the tx offset.",
      "clears_with": "answer",

      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Sort extra spenders by (height, tx_offset) using CDiskTxPos from txospenderindex instead of reading full blocks.",
      "quote": "Ordering spenders doesn't need a block read. txospenderindex keys already store a CDiskTxPos, and its nTxOffset grows with the transaction's position in the block.",

      "part": 4,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Have Find take the whole set of script hashes to avoid duplicate transaction reads and simplify post-processing.",
      "quote": "Find could take the whole set of script hashes. Today the RPC calls Find once per hash and merges results by (height, tx_offset).",

      "text": "Unify index-layer and RPC-layer budget enforcement and error reporting into a single type.",
      "quote": "One budget, one error. Index lookups charge a uint64_t& and fail with \"Script history index lookup limit exceeded…\". Extra transaction bodies throw a std::runtime_error",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",

      "text": "Move getscripthistory RPC handler into its own file (src/rpc/scripthistory.cpp) with one function per step.",

claims.text: The lookup budget does not count block and undo reads, allowing queries that fit in the 50 MiB budget to read far more disk than intended.
claims.quote: The lookup budget does not count block and undo reads. At verbosity 2, tx_to_json reads the full block and its undo data for every block that holds a non-coinbase match

claims.quote: OrderedVarInt could be BigEndianFormatter<3>. Big-endian already sorts by height, and the same key already uses it for the tx offset.

claims.text: Sort extra spenders by (height, tx_offset) using CDiskTxPos from txospenderindex instead of reading full blocks.
claims.quote: Ordering spenders doesn't need a block read. txospenderindex keys already store a CDiskTxPos, and its nTxOffset grows with the transaction's position in the block.

claims.text: Have Find take the whole set of script hashes to avoid duplicate transaction reads and simplify post-processing.
claims.quote: Find could take the whole set of script hashes. Today the RPC calls Find once per hash and merges results by (height, tx_offset).

claims.text: Unify index-layer and RPC-layer budget enforcement and error reporting into a single type.
claims.quote: One budget, one error. Index lookups charge a uint64_t& and fail with "Script history index lookup limit exceeded…". Extra transaction bodies throw a std::runtime_error

claims.text: Move getscripthistory RPC handler into its own file (src/rpc/scripthistory.cpp) with one function per step.
claims.quote: Could the RPC go in its own file? blockchain.cpp grows by ~530 lines to 4,238. The handler is one ~400-line lambda that opens with a 12-step index comment.

claims.text: Avoid SHA256 hashing for script indexing since Electrum 1.7.x protocol now uses scriptPubKey-based queries directly.
